question.text: Head and Shoulders pattern is a:

answer.text: Continuation pattern indicating the trend will continue
Reversal pattern signaling a potential change in trend direction
Pattern found only on monthly charts
Pattern that predicts exact price targets

explanation.text: The Logic: Head and Shoulders is a reversal pattern that signals a potential change in trend direction. A classic Head and Shoulders top forms at the end of an uptrend - three peaks where the middle peak (the head) is the highest and the two outer peaks (the shoulders) are roughly equal - with a neckline whose break confirms the reversal. The inverse Head and Shoulders, at the bottom of a downtrend, is a bullish reversal. The Trap: Option A wrongly classifies it as a continuation pattern. Head and Shoulders charts are used to identify support and resistance zones at the neckline and to anticipate a trend change, not its continuation. Note: Source - NISM-Series-XV Research Analyst workbook (February 2026), chart-patterns section, pp. 295 and 313 (and surrounding pages).
